lines.en: I flap over on my wings.
I sweep low over the grass.
My feathers turn in the wind.

lines.zh: 我掠着屋顶，一圈一圈地飞。
lines.en: I skim the rooftop, circle after circle.
I stop midair and glide.
I come in from the hills.
I call as I fly.
My talons sway below me.
I fly along the treetops.
I suddenly rise a few blocks.
I drift slowly your way.
I bank and come back.
The beat of my wings is loud.
I perch on the fence and take off again.
I fly toward the space above you.

lines.zh: 我收翅落下来，走了两步。
lines.en: I fold my wings, land, and walk two steps.
I hover, wings beating slowly.
I watch the ground from above.
My feathers are bright.

lines.zh: 我收拢翅膀，立在枯枝上。
lines.en: I fold my wings and perch on a dead branch.
I barely move in the wind.

lines.zh: 我低头梳理胸前的羽毛。
lines.en: I bend to preen the feathers on my chest.
I tilt to look.
My wings are spread wide.
I wait for the wind to carry me down.
I slowly tip my head.
My tail feathers shiver.
I hang beneath the clouds.
I look down at you, directly.
My eyes are sharp.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向叫了一声。
lines.en: I cry out your way.
I am estimating your height.
I drop one block.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛在你头上投下影子。
lines.en: My wings cast a shadow on you.
I raise one talon.

lines.zh: 我落在你的视线边缘，歪下头。
lines.en: I land at the edge of your sight and tilt my head.
I circle directly above you.
My cry echoes in the hills.

lines.zh: 翅膀上缺了一块，我飞得发飘。
lines.en: A gap in my wing makes my flight wobble.
I spin before steadying.

lines.zh: 我发出一声短促的啼叫。
lines.en: I give one short shriek.
I climb a few blocks.
I beat my wings.
My talons pull in.

lines.zh: 我掉了几片羽毛，才稳住身子。
lines.en: I lose a few feathers before I steady myself.
I stare and my cry grows shriller.
My wings tremble.
I do not come down.
I circle once before dropping.
I land two blocks from it.

lines.zh: 我偏头看看，再啄一小口。
lines.en: I tilt my head, then take a small peck.
I pick it up and set it down.
This is not what I usually eat.

lines.zh: 我抬头看还有没有更多。
lines.en: I look up for more.
I kick it.
I carry it up into a tree.
I give two short cries.
I sniff and walk off.
You hit me and feathers scatter.
My wing buffets your face.
I pull up and reset my balance.
I skim past your shoulder.
We land one heavy thump.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一乱，斜着滑出去。
lines.en: My wings tangle and I slide off sideways.
My talons rake your hand.
The wingwash pushes you back a step.
I climb a few blocks.
I cry out, displeased.
Two harpies cross in the air.

lines.zh: 我们并排停在崖边，梳着羽。
lines.en: We perch side by side on the cliff, preening.
I fly half a circle around her.
We climb together.

lines.zh: 她的叫声和我的合在一起。
lines.en: Her cry joins mine.
We land together on the cliff.
I preen her neck feathers.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在地上重叠。
lines.en: Our shadows overlap on the ground.
We fly off together.

lines.zh: 它们的爪子抓同一块石头。
lines.en: Their talons grip the same stone.

lines.zh: 我收爪，把它扣在掌心里。
lines.en: I close my talons and cage it in my grip.
I carry it up into the air.
I drop it into the nest.
It sways in my grip.
I nudge it to my talons with my beak.
It is too heavy; I dip lower.
I open my talons and it drops.

lines.zh: 我抓着它，落到崖边的巢里。
lines.en: I carry it down to the nest on the cliff.
I lift off and settle again.
I carry it to the cliff's edge.
I stop midair and turn to you.

lines.zh: 我认出下面有活的东西。
lines.en: I recognize something alive below.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，找落爪的地方。
lines.en: I circle you, looking for a place to land.
I spread my wings fully.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，朝你的头顶滑。
lines.en: I drop low and glide for the space above your head.
My talons come out.
I have chosen that target.
My height is just right.
I begin closing the distance.
I stop circling in the air.

lines.zh: 我从云里钻出，朝你俯冲。
lines.en: I break from the clouds and dive at you.
I lower my head and aim.
I fly along with you.
Wherever you run, my shadow follows.
I am three blocks above your head.

lines.zh: 我抢在你前头，落在屋檐上。
lines.en: I cut ahead of you and land on the eaves.
You hide inside; I am on the roof.
I cry once and change position.
I hold this altitude.

lines.zh: 你退到树下，我落在枝上。
lines.en: You back under a tree; I land on a branch.

lines.zh: 我数着你还有几处能躲。
lines.en: I count the remaining places you can hide.
The beat of my wings keeps following.
You look up and I have moved.
I am only two blocks off.
I dive and rake you.
My talons tear your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我从侧面掠过，爪尖扫到你。
lines.en: I sweep past your flank and my talons graze you.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下去，爪子先着地。
lines.en: I dive, talons leading the way.

lines.zh: 我一爪拍过去，你抬臂挡住。
lines.en: I swipe and you catch it on your arm.
I strike and rise away.
Feathers fly in front of you.
My tail feathers whip your head.
You raise an arm against my talons.
I cut in again from the side.

lines.zh: 我一声尖啸，从云底落下来。
lines.en: I shriek and drop out from under the clouds.
You hear a shrill cry.
A bird lands on the cliff.
I beat my wings in midair.

lines.zh: 这里多了一个盘旋的东西。
lines.en: Something is circling here now.
My shadow sweeps the ground first.
I begin circling overhead.
The wind suddenly picks up.
I stop on your roof.
I fold my wings, then spread them.

lines.zh: 火烤到我的羽毛，我急忙往上飞。
lines.en: Fire singes my feathers and I climb fast.

lines.zh: 我从高空中摔下来，砸在地上。
lines.en: I drop from high up and hit the ground.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛湿了，飞不起来。
lines.en: My feathers soak and I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，翻了两个跟头。
lines.en: The blast flips me twice.
An arrow pierces my wing.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的翅膀压住。
lines.en: That force pins my wings.
Hunger leaves me too weak to beat my wings.

lines.zh: 雷击在我身上，羽毛全竖起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my feathers all stand up.

lines.zh: 下面的天没了，我一直坠。
lines.en: The sky below is gone; I fall.
